title: Steel City Jet Ski Rentals
specs: Ride throughout downtown Pittsburgh on all three rivers within an 8 mile boundary
Short 7 minute ride to Point State Park from launch point
Must be 18 or older to operate a jet ski
Maximum weight limit 350 pounds per jet ski
Operator must have driver's license and matching ID
Operators must watch safety video and take quiz to get temporary PA boaters certificate if needed
Jet skis seat two adults or one adult and two kids under 10
includes: Life jackets provided from infant size to 4XL
blurb: Guests rent jet skis from a launch point in Sharpsburg and can ride throughout downtown Pittsburgh on all three rivers within an 8 mile rental boundary. Operators watch a safety video and take a quiz to obtain a free temporary PA boaters certificate if needed. Jet skis seat up to two adults or one adult and two kids under 10, with a strict 350 pound weight limit.
extraNote: Full refund if operator cancels due to weather; refunds or rebooking allowed if customer cancels due to rain; forced cancellations only for lightning · Waiver and temporary certificate info sent in advance; arrive 30 minutes early if not completed · White trailer at marina accessed off S19th street near the river in Sharpsburg
